name: Ballroom
_notes: Ballroom - a literal enclosed room in deathball's real pit (the flat ~165x135m bowl at world x235-400 z585-720, floor ~y1-3): four wall boxes spanning y-5..15 around a ~30x30m interior + a roof slab, so the 28 fodder balls ricochet inside. Solo entry: OFFLINE > BALLS > BALLROOM, or deep link /?mode=classic&map=ballroom. Classic mode forces variant-0 balls so ballMix is host-only.
